item.title: Thesis #4
item.description:
(here is a small example I created yesteday and finished just now about pending jobs. Nevertheless, I’m not entirely sure whether its fully correct.

This is because I am unsure whether it is correct to approach 0 budget in this model representation, and, more importantly, what the exact tiebreaker is for two tasks that arrive at the server a the same time. Even when I extend this notion to SCHED_DEADLINE, I am still unsure what the exact tiebreak should entail. In a future post, I hope to address these two questions.
